data.title: 砂狼白子 · 沿海公路的长途骑行微汗
data.description: 长途公路骑行结束后的海滨防波堤上，海浪拍打着礁石。白子单腿跨在公路自行车大梁上，拉开紧身骑行服的前胸拉链，露出吸汗背心与微热起伏的锁骨。汗水顺着脸颊滑落到修长颈项，狼耳随海风轻微颤动。她拿起水壶喝了一大口清水，转过头来擦了擦嘴角，向你递出明澈坚定的信任目光。
data.action: drinking from water bottle, wiping mouth with wrist, unzipped cycling jersey, sweat glistening, bright determined gaze looking at viewer
data.location: concrete coastal seawall overlooking azure ocean under sunny sky
data.lighting: crisp bright coastal sunlight glinting off ocean waves and bicycle frame
data.mood: refreshing athletic vitality, cool breeze youthful connection
data.promptProse: Resting on her road bicycle along a coastal seawall, Shiroko pulls down her cycling jersey zipper after a hard ride. Sweat glistens on her bare collarbones as she turns with a refreshing, confident gaze in the ocean wind.
data.animaCaption: Shiroko resting by her bicycle on a coastal road with unzipped jersey and glistening sweat.
